start: A woman walks towards the camera on a pale stone runway against a plain off-white wall, in a plain mid-grey knee-length dress with long sleeves and black flat shoes.
A1: The same look with a bold gold chain necklace and small gold drop earrings.
A2: The dress replaced by a fitted grey top and a grey pleated skirt to below the knee, with the gold necklace and earrings.
A3: The pleated skirt now sheer grey tulle over a short slip, her legs showing through it, with the grey top and gold necklace.
A4: Small beads scattered over the grey top, above the sheer pleated skirt, with the gold necklace and earrings.
A5: A grey belt tied in a bow at the waist of the beaded top and the sheer pleated skirt, with the gold necklace and earrings.
B1: The same plain knee-length dress with long sleeves, now black, with black flat shoes.
B2: A plain black top with long sleeves and straight black trousers to the floor over black boots.
B3: An oversized black wool coat with wide padded shoulders, worn open over the black top and trousers.
B4: The oversized coat now in smooth black leather, over the black top and trousers.
B5: Dark wraparound sunglasses with the oversized black leather coat, black top and trousers.
